_comment: Tor Web Hosting - one isolated Tor v3 onion service per Pterodactyl server
name: Tor Web Hosting
author: Crackhead-gsk
description: Nginx, PHP-FPM and a persistent Tor v3 onion service per customer container.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash set -e cd /mnt/server mkdir -p public_html .tor/hidden_service .tor/data logs if [ ! -f public_html/index.php ] && [ ! -f public_html/index.html ]; then cat > public_html/index.php <<'PHP' Tor Web Hosting

Your onion website is running.

'; PHP fi chmod 755 public_html chmod 700 .tor .tor/hidden_service .tor/data chown -R 1000:1000 /mnt/server echo 'Tor Web Hosting files initialized.'

variables.name: Web Root
variables.description: Website directory. This image currently supports public_html.

variables.name: Tor Enabled
variables.description: Enable the Tor v3 onion service.

variables.name: Onion Port
variables.description: Virtual port exposed by the onion service.
